verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs cover installing, configuring, updating and maintaining your own instance through several first-party routes: the Linux package, official Docker images, Helm chart or Operator, and self-compilation, plus recommended scaling configurations and instance-level admin controls for Self-Managed. Community users independently confirm running private and VM-based instances. Missing for 10: detailed upgrade-path documentation beyond a one-line mention, and evidence that backup/maintenance is reliable, since one self-managed user reported backup regressions in 8.15–8.16.
